story.titleZh: 拉斯维加斯大奖赛2026：赢家与输家
story.summaryZh: The Race评选2026年F1拉斯维加斯大奖赛的赢家与输家，法拉利双车手汉密尔顿与勒克莱尔因内斗碰撞双双受罚，拉塞尔争胜未果撞墙退赛。
story.originalTitle: Winners and losers from F1's 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix
story.summaryEn: The Race picks the winners and losers from F1's 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix, where Ferrari team-mates Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc collided and were penalised, and George Russell crashed out while fighting for the win.
detailZh: 一场持续不断的领先争夺战是拉斯维加斯大奖赛的最大看点，但参与其中的车手应对方式却大相径庭。
以下是我们评选出的这场F1拉斯维加斯史上最精彩比赛中的赢家与输家：
在这个轮对轮厮杀近乎疯狂的比赛日里，最容易出事的车手似乎注定是法拉利队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔。
两人一路杀入领先车阵后，在汉密尔顿因与兰多·诺里斯争夺时切弯被罚10秒之前，两人就因互相缠斗而愈发不满。
但即便如此，两人最终还是发生了不必要的碰撞——这让汉密尔顿名次大幅下滑，也让勒克莱尔吃到了罚单。
在墨西哥站事件后，两人公开表示法拉利队内一切良好，但拉斯维加斯站表明，仍有许多问题需要解决。——乔恩·诺布尔
有机会争胜却在缠斗中处于下风，最终赛车撞墙退赛，拉斯维加斯站几乎就是拉塞尔整个赛季的缩影。
他与维斯塔潘的较量，感觉有点像一个小得多的弟弟试图去摔赢一个大得多、年长得多的哥哥。即便拉塞尔看似占得上风，维斯塔潘也能轻松反扑。而在其余时间里，拉塞尔面对逆境显得有些无可奈何。
在试图反超队友基米·安东内利时发生撞车，他说道：“我知道如果我想赢得这场比赛，就必须在最后几圈前处在第二的位置。”
“基米当时没有超车模式，我选择了一次高风险的超车动作，并付出了代价。但我不后悔。当然，我对此感到失望。但我本可以保守一些，那样我会以第三名完赛。”
他为了争取到能与维斯塔潘抗衡的位置而撞车，这在一定程度上印证了这位红牛车手的评价——拉塞尔不在他的水平上，即便我们加上一个前提：这是就今年目前的情况而言。——杰克·本尼恩
在这样一场混乱的比赛中，领先位置的争夺出现了卡丁车级别的多次交替，像维斯塔潘这样的赛车猛兽最终胜出，并不令人意外。
维斯塔潘的判断非常出色，他保持冷静，在驾驶和策略上都胜过了两位梅赛德斯车手，赢得了六场比赛中的第四场胜利。——JS
一切似乎都在朝着安东内利有利的方向发展，他采用的非对称策略让他在最后一段换上软胎，看起来使他成为维斯塔潘争夺胜利的主要威胁，这场较量将在冲刺到终点线的过程中展开。
但在这个他出色地驾驭了2026款动力单元各种特性的年份里，安东内利却犯了错。
他为了与维斯塔潘保持理想差距而收油，结果却打乱了他的能量部署——因为能量管理算法的反应是在他不想消耗过多电力时却消耗了过多电力。
这一结果让他对迈凯伦双雄兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里失去了势头，意味着他在本可以再夺一场精彩胜利的这一天错失了领奖台。 - JN
考虑到迈凯伦在拉斯维加斯的直线速度“糟糕透顶”，诺里斯和皮亚斯特里双双登上领奖台对迈凯伦而言是了不起的超额成就。
尽管存在这一弱点，两人都跑出了非常聪明的比赛，充分利用了列车中的行驶，并在超车位置上做出了明智的选择。
这对皮亚斯特里尤其令人鼓舞，他能够从第17位冲到第三位，这是自五月初迈阿密站以来他首次登上大奖赛领奖台。 - JS
林德布拉德在比赛初期一度高居第三，但后来在安全车下打滑，犯下了赛车界的一大忌讳。
他说自己经历了一次奇怪的状态变化，称这是“我经历过的最奇怪的事情”，但他也补充说，他想为所发生的事情承担责任。
他最大的遗憾是什么？“我可以在接下来几场比赛中争夺第八、第九、第十名。那太棒了。作为新秀赛季，驾驶中游赛车争夺第三、第四、第五名，这样的机会并不多。我觉得这才是让我难受的地方。”
林德布拉德觉得他最近在墨西哥排位赛中错过了类似的机会。你能看出他非常渴望一场头条表现，来证明这个许多人尚未注意到的强劲赛季。——JB
目前来看，车队积分榜第五名似乎仍然遥不可及，但阿尔派在拉斯维加斯已经做得不能再多了，因为小红牛的两辆赛车都遇到了麻烦。
皮埃尔·加斯利一度跑到第三位，并凭借一场精彩的表现以第五名完赛，在终点线前与安东内利展开争夺，尽管由于过热问题，他在50圈中的45圈里都调低了动力输出。
阿尔派将对此进行复盘，但最终加斯利还是很满意，即便在他到达第三位的那一刻，他觉得自己本可以为胜利而战。
弗朗哥·科拉平托的比赛则更像是一场过山车，他需要一些帮助，得益于包括夏尔·勒克莱尔（罚时）和拉塞尔（撞车后以第六名完赛）在内的多位车手在比赛后期出现的问题。
但他从早期使用旧软胎毫无抓地力的困境中恢复过来——起步时他上升了三个位置，但很快又丢了回去——最终稳稳进入前十，无论前方车手遇到什么问题。
距离小红牛车队的制造商积分差距是27分，还剩两场比赛。- JB
这是第一场真正让人感觉哈贾尔有争胜威胁的比赛，但在早期安全车后重新起步时，他的前翼立刻弯曲，在灾难性的情况下崩盘了。
如果你以为他赛后会很沮丧，他的言论简直令人不安。
他说：“这甚至无关积分或领奖台，只是破坏了我的乐趣。”
“我来这里是为了和世界上最优秀的车手比赛，结果却落到后面，只能独自驾驶。这正在消磨我开车的动力。真是太烦人了。我想我永远不知道自己本可以取得什么样的成绩。”
但你可以选择对此持更加积极的看法。他提出了一个可以说更好的比赛策略，即在前方不断交换位置以试图拉开差距，而维斯塔潘似乎在赛道上否决了这一策略。他也是迄今为止对胜利最具威胁的一次，而且正如在巴库那样，他在这类街道赛道上证明了自己是一个真正的竞争者。
从结果来看是输家，但在表现上绝对不是。——JB
比赛结束时，肯定会有非常多的人盯着计时塔问：卡洛斯·塞恩斯到底是怎么跑到第八名的？
这一切的基础是令人印象深刻的开场几圈，塞恩斯从第18位升到了第11位。
此后，他在安全车之后一直紧咬领先集团，然后在终点线前抓住机会，超越了被阻挡的拉塞尔（拉塞尔被汉密尔顿挡在后面），拿下本赛季最好的第八名，远超目前威廉姆斯赛车应有的位置。——JS
detailEn: A relentless lead battle was the defining feature of the Las Vegas Grand Prix, but the way the drivers involved in it dealt with it varied drastically.
Here's our pick of winners and losers from Formula 1's most entertaining Vegas race yet:
On a day of frantic wheel-to-wheel racing there seemed almost an inevitability that the drivers most likely to hit trouble would be Ferrari team-mates Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc.

Having hauled themselves into the train of cars at the front, frustrations were growing between the pair about battling each other prior to Hamilton picking up his 10-second penalty for cutting the track in a fight with Lando Norris.
But even after that, the pair ended up needlessly colliding - dumping Hamilton down the order and earning Leclerc a penalty.
After all the public talk of things being rosy between the Ferrari duo after their Mexico incident, Las Vegas has shown there is still a lot that needs to be fixed. - Jon Noble
Contending for the win but inferior in battle, and ending the race in the wall, Vegas just about sums up Russell's season.

His battle with Verstappen felt a bit like a much, much younger brother trying to wrestle a much older, bigger one. Even when Russell looked to have the upper hand, Verstappen stormed back with ease. And the rest of the time Russell looked a bit hapless in the face of adversity.
On his crash, while trying to repass team-mate Kimi Antonelli, he said: "I knew if I wanted to win the race, I needed to be in second going into the last couple of laps.

"Kimi didn't have the overtake mode and I went for a high-risk move and paid the price. But I don't regret it. Of course, I'm disappointed with it. But I could have been conservative and I would have finished in third."

The fact that he crashed trying to even get in a position to fight Verstappen lends some credence to the Red Bull driver's assessment that Russell is not on his level is true, even if we add the caveat that that's as things stand this year. - Jack Benyon
In such a chaotic race with karting-levels of passes for the lead, it's little surprise that a racing animal such as Verstappen emerged on top.
Verstappen judged things beautifully, keeping a calm head, outdriving and out-strategising both Mercedes drivers for a fourth victory in six races. - JS

It all seemed to be coming to Antonelli as his offset strategy that put him on softs for the final stint appeared to leave him as Verstappen's main threat for the win, as part of a battle that would play out in the dash to the line.
But in a year where he has been brilliant in managing the quirks of these 2026 power units, Antonelli got it wrong.

Having lifted off to keep the ideal gap to Verstappen, that ended up messing up his deployment - as the response from the energy-management algorithms was to burn too much power when he didn't want it to be used up.
The result was a loss of momentum to McLaren duo Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri that meant he missed out on a podium on a day when he had it in his hands to pull off another brilliant win. - JN
Considering McLaren had "horrendous" straightline speed in Las Vegas, Norris and Piastri earning a double podium is a fantastic overachievement for McLaren.
They both drove really clever races despite that weakness, making the most of running in the train and being smart with where they made their overtakes.
That was particularly encouraging for Piastri, who was able to charge from 17th to third for his first grand podium since Miami in early-May. - JS
As high as third in the early running, Lindblad later committed one of racing's faux pas by spinning under the safety car.
He said he'd had a weird shift which was "the strangest thing I've experienced", but did caveat that he wanted to take the blame for what had happened.

His biggest regret? "I can race for P8, P9, P10 in the next couple of races. That's fantastic. Not often you get to race for P3, P4, P5 in a midfield car in your rookie season. I think that's what hurts me."

Lindblad felt he missed a similar chance in Mexico qualifying recently. You can tell he's desperate for a headline performance to back up what has been a strong season that many people haven't yet noticed. - JB
It still feels like fifth place in the constructors' championship is out of reach, but Alpine couldn't have done much more in Las Vegas, as both Racing Bulls cars hit trouble.
Pierre Gasly ran as high as third, and pulled off a majestic drive to fifth fighting Antonelli to the flag, despite running 45 of the 50 laps with the power turned down due to an overheating issue.
Alpine will review that, but ultimately Gasly was happy even if at the point he reached third he felt he could fight for the win.
Franco Colapinto's race was much more of a rollercoaster, and he needed some help from late issues from various drivers including Charles Leclerc (penalty) and Russell (crash to finish sixth).
But he recovered from having no grip on used softs early on - he gained three places at the start but lost those quickly - to a sure-thing top 10 regardless of the issues of those ahead.
The constructors' points gap to Racing Bulls is 27 with two races to go. - JB

This was the first race where it really felt like Hadjar was a threat for victory, and it fell apart in catastrophic circumstances as his front wing buckled right after the restart following the early safety car.
If you expected him to be sombre after the race, his comments were borderline troubling.
"It's not even about the points or the podium, it's just ruining my fun," he said.

"I'm here to race the best guys in the world and I end up at the back and having to race alone. It's just ruining my motivation to drive. It's just so annoying. I guess I never know what kind of result I could have had."

But you can choose to take a much more positive view of this. He suggested what would have arguably been a better race strategy, to keep swapping positions at the front to try and build a gap, which Verstappen seemingly vetoed on track. He was the most threatening for a win that he's looked so far too and, as in Baku, he showed on these sorts of street circuits that he's a proper contender.
A loser from the result, but certainly not in performance. - JB
There will have been an awful lot of people looking at the timing tower at the end of the race asking: how on earth did Carlos Sainz end up eighth?
The bedrock of that was an impressive set of opening laps as Sainz went from 18th to 11th.

Thereafter, he kept sight of the leading pack after the safety car, then picked off a baulked Russell (who was caught behind Hamilton) with an opportunistic move just before the line to take a season's-best eighth, far above where the current Williams should be. - JS
keyPointsZh: 汉密尔顿在与诺里斯争夺中切弯被罚10秒
法拉利双车最终以第7和第10名完赛
拉塞尔在试图反超队友安东内利时撞墙，最终第9名
keyPointsEn: Hamilton received a 10-second penalty for cutting the track in a fight with Norris
Russell hit the wall while trying to repass team-mate Antonelli and finished ninth

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 2026 Qatar Grand Prix qualifying results
detailZh: 乔治·拉塞尔夺得杆位，梅赛德斯车队在卡塔尔大奖赛排位赛中占据领先，这是自5月份加拿大大奖赛以来的首次。
以下是排位赛三部分的全部结果：
11 Ollie 贝尔曼 (哈斯) 1m23.367s +0.240s (与Q3差距)
17 塞恩斯 (威廉姆斯) 1m24.370s +0.096s (与Q2差距)
19 安东内利·阿隆索 (阿斯顿·马丁) +0.436秒
detailEn: George Russell claimed pole position as Mercedes dominated Qatar Grand Prix qualifying for its first one-two since the Canadian Grand Prix in May.
Here are the full results from all three parts of qualifying:
11 Ollie Bearman (Haas) 1m23.367s +0.240s (gap to Q3)
17 Carlos Sainz (Williams) 1m24.370s +0.096s (gap to Q2)
19 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +0.436s

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
